title: Vegetarian Culinary Culture
origins: Vegetarian cuisine reflects global geography, trade routes, and home cooking traditions passed through generations.
history: Plant-forward cooking with global spice access — technique over tradition lock-in.
teaching: Roast vegetables deeply, use nutritional yeast and miso for umami, acid and crunch for finish.
Legumes, grains, olive oil, and bold spice rack.
Signature pairing: herbs + grains + olive oil.
